_comment: TOOL-SHOT-001 shot definitions. JSON rather than YAML: the Python env here
has no PyYAML and this config is not worth a new dependency.
static - one frame from an exact camera pose
orbit  - N frames around a pivot; lets the reviewer judge proportions,
silhouette and scale from every angle, not just one lucky one
Target corridors come from the art direction reference: Broken Arrow
(modern military RTS, top-down tactical). Desaturated but not grey,
readable midtones, almost no blown highlights.

shots.name: board_overview
shots.description: Whole 8x8 board from the standard tactical angle. The frame the player sees most.

shots.name: board_low_angle
shots.description: Low tactical angle - exposes silhouettes against the sky and any flat lighting.

shots.name: unit_orbit
shots.description: Turntable around a single unit. Judges proportions, panel detail and scale versus the tile from all sides.

shots.name: environment_orbit
shots.description: Wide turntable around the board centre - terrain, props and the border ring from every side.
